environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate with default configuration. Image built from rust:1.75-slim with ldap-utils installed. Container has network access to internal LDAP server on port 389. Service account cn=svc-auth has broad read permissions across the directory tree. No input validation middleware or WAF in front of the service. Container filesystem is writable (default Docker behavior).

config.network: VPC with direct access to ldap-server:389
config.ldap_acl: svc-auth has subtree read on dc=corp,dc=internal
